prompts.house-of-worlds:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-page editorial architectural concept illustration for an illustrated speculative near-future worldbook.
Primary request: A House of Worlds where shared architecture supports many voluntary ways of living. Show one credible, generous daylight atrium in a low-rise community building. Tall timber-and-steel structure, plants, soft stone floor, accessible ordinary passenger lift, continuous clear floor path. Through a clearly real doorway in the middle distance, an optional immersive room shows a fantastical cloud harbor as a wall-scale projected environment, confined beyond that threshold. In an adjacent glazed studio, several people practice dance. A secluded quiet bench with one person reading. A small group of ordinary diverse adults, two wearing subtle optional AR glasses and others without; all belong to the same usable real building.
Style/medium: warm and sophisticated editorial architectural photography blended with finely observed realistic concept art, tactile materials, lived-in everyday clothing and natural people, dignified ordinary life.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 horizontal frame at human eye height, one coherent space with depth and clear circulation, restrained camera perspective; not a collage.
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse indoor daylight from skylights, gentle warm material color, calm and quietly inspiring.
Constraints: Grounded and buildable near-future architecture; the space remains legible and usable without glasses. Ordinary full-body human proportions and safe rails. No lettering, captions, labels, signage, logos or watermarks. No sci-fi skyscrapers, flying cars, holographic interface graphics, spectacle crowds, sunset glow, opaque overdesigned machinery. This is an illustrative proposal, not an engineering drawing.
prompts.open-university:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-page editorial architectural concept illustration for an illustrated speculative near-future worldbook.
Primary request: An Open University as a welcoming neighborhood learning commons rather than a branded elite campus. A low-rise, human-scale public courtyard with a library visible behind glazing, and a modest instrument workshop opening toward the courtyard. In the foreground, a younger adult learner and an elder study a physical natural specimen together on a table with a microscope. Across the garden, two people practice fluid movement; another ordinary person rests comfortably with no demand to participate. A visible open doorway leads to a shared kitchen in the background. Books, instruments, plants, shade, well-used tables and paths that invite all ages.
Style/medium: warm editorial architectural photography blended with finely observed realistic concept art, natural people, tactile used materials, candid unposed interaction.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 horizontal frame at seated-to-standing eye height, integrated coherent courtyard scene with depth; foreground learning table, generous calm middle ground and inhabitable background. No collage or split frames.
Lighting/mood: soft bright overcast daylight, welcoming gentle greens, timber and pale masonry, relaxed daily life.
Constraints: Credible near-future architecture using contemporary construction, wheelchair-usable connected paths, no extravagant sci-fi buildings. No lettering, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or campus branding. No repeated cloned faces or crowds, no sunset haze. Knowledge is visibly accessible and life includes rest. This is an illustrative proposal, not an engineering drawing.
prompts.material-lives:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-page editorial architectural concept illustration for an illustrated speculative near-future worldbook.
Primary request: A human-scale neighborhood material library and repair commons adjoining a common kitchen and planted courtyard. Tell the story of materials having many useful lives. In foreground left, a tidy cup return shelf holds a few used metal drinking cups in a tray; behind a clear utility partition lies a washing station, and a separate clean shelf holds neatly nested stainless steel cups for people to take near the common kitchen. Show this arrangement without words. Midground right, through a separate service entrance into a bounded sheltered service yard, racks hold orderly reusable steel beams and bolted building components; one person and a compact wheeled inspection robot inspect a component on a stable workbench. The yard has a clear physical boundary from the public courtyard, with no industrial work crossing the public walkway. Beyond, ordinary adults share food and conversation in the planted courtyard.
Style/medium: warm editorial architectural photography blended with finely observed realistic concept art, tactile metal surfaces, timber shelving, credible purposeful details, ordinary dignified people.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 horizontal framing at human eye height, coherent one-place architectural scene showing public commons and separated service area; material reuse is readable without any explanatory graphics.
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse daylight, warm neutral timber and modest green planting, unglamorous care made beautiful.
Constraints: No metal melting, furnaces, sparks or cups fabricated beside food; maintenance stays physically separated from food and public circulation. No lettering, captions, labels, signage, logos or watermark. No futuristic city skyline, humanoid robot army, gadget clutter or sunset. This is an illustrative proposal, not an engineering drawing.
